answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake before it can trade, slashed if peers later prove duplicate control. A single voyage of honest work earns back only one stake, so an attacker spinning up a thousand ivory-tower clones must lock a thousand stakes and risk losing them all on detection. Rate-limit new identities per verified hardware attestation, like an onyx seal bound to one device, so cheap sock-puppets cannot flood the market before the stake even matters.
